label: Quiet star
why: A quiet Sun-like star from SS-0001: planets are easy to find here.

label: Pulsator, 4.6 h
why: SS-0001 found a 4.6-hour oscillation that hides injected planets from biweight cleaning.

label: Pulsator, 3.7 h
why: A 3.7-hour oscillation whose amplitude changes from quarter to quarter.

label: Spotted star, 3-day rotation
why: Fast rotation with large spots: the hardest case for every method in SS-0002A.

label: Spotted star, 10-day rotation
why: Slow rotation: biweight cleaning should cope.

label: Delta Scuti pulsator
why: A real multi-mode pulsator (Murphy et al. 2019): messier than SS-0002A's simulated ones.
